frozen_context_artifact.generation_rule: All checked-in ORD July 2-31 packs using scripts/benchmark_backtests.py status-agnostic timestamp gating and frozen three-candidate formulas.
frozen_context_artifact.visibility_policy: An actual ORD timestamp at or before issue time controls visibility; eventual cancellation/diversion flags are excluded from all selector inputs.

provenance.selector_implementation: Exact backtest.py::_local_model_choice prompt contract over candidates generated by scripts/benchmark_backtests.py.

prompt_contract.system_message: Return one strict JSON object with exactly candidate_id and summary. Choose one supplied candidate_id. In summary, cite at least one provided number or weather signal and explain the choice in under 25 words.
prompt_contract.task: Choose exactly one allowlisted next-hour aggregate forecast. Do not invent an ID or operational action.
prompt_contract.ground_truth_use: Realized outcomes were used after inference for scoring and to define sampling strata; they were absent from model prompts.

sampling.rule: Rank all 30 days by realized union disruption rate; split into 10-day LOW/MIDDLE/HIGH tertiles; take within-stratum ranks 1,5,10; score fixed issue times 06:00,09:00,12:00,15:00,18:00,21:00.
sampling.selection_note: Realized full-day disruption defines low/middle/high coverage only. The model did not receive the stratum or realized outcome.

latency_seconds.timing_note: Wall-clock observations on the shared development host after cohort regeneration completed; timings may include ordinary ambient host load.

selector_diagnostics.interpretation: The selector was valid and below its 30-second timeout, but it produced the same numeric forecast as always choosing WEATHER_STRESS on every sampled window. Candidate generation, rather than selector model size, is the primary forecast-quality constraint.

auxiliary_full_population_candidate_metr.scope: Frozen three-candidate and deterministic policies only; Qwen was not run across the full 638-window population.

tests.input: Same strict selector contract on one severe replay window

gemma4_26b_feasibility_check.conclusion: Not feasible as the local interactive selector on this 24 GiB host under the 30-second decision SLA; no forecast-quality comparison was possible.
